credit_line: Gift of Peter Stein, Fred Stein Archive
description: Vertical portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe sitting at her dining room (plywood) table at Ghost Ranch looking looking in the direction of viewer left, her face is in profile with her hand by her neck;  her hair is pulled back in a bun and she is wearing a black wrap dress; visible behind her is the wall and a partial view of the white curtained window.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
